verdict.rationale: Stripe's platform-wide webhooks system (docs.stripe.com/webhooks) lets integrators register HTTPS endpoints and receive real-time events, and this applies to Terminal-related events (e.g., payment_intent, terminal.reader events) as part of the broader Stripe API that Terminal integrations build on. Missing for 10: Terminal-specific webhook event documentation (e.g., reader-specific event types) and independent hands-on confirmation of webhook reliability for Terminal use cases specifically.
